title: Emergent BioSolutions Receives Saudi Food and Drug Authority Approval for ACAM2000® [Smallpox and Mpox (Vaccinia) Vaccine, Live]
summary: GAITHERSBURG, Md., May 18, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Emergent BioSolutions (NYSE:EBS), a global biodefense company, today announced that the Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA) has approved the registration of ACAM2000® [Smallpox and Mpox (Vaccinia) Vaccine, Live], for the prevention of smallpox
